title: Define Todo type and implement todoReducer
active_form: Defining Todo type and implementing todoReducer
description:
Create the Todo TypeScript interface with fields: id (string), text (string), completed (boolean). Implement the todoReducer function that handles all action types: ADD (creates new todo with unique id and completed: false), DELETE (removes todo by id), TOGGLE (flips completed status), EDIT (updates text by id), CLEAR_COMPLETED (removes all completed todos), and TOGGLE_ALL (marks all complete if any incomplete, or all incomplete if all complete). Define the TodoAction discriminated union type for type-safe dispatch.

Source: internal/specs/todo-app-SPEC.md Sections 7.4, 13.3

functional: Todo interface defined with id, text, and completed fields
TodoAction union type covers ADD, DELETE, TOGGLE, EDIT, CLEAR_COMPLETED, TOGGLE_ALL
ADD action creates a new todo with a unique id and completed: false
DELETE action removes the todo matching the given id
TOGGLE action flips the completed boolean for the given id
EDIT action updates the text for the given id
CLEAR_COMPLETED action removes all todos where completed is true
TOGGLE_ALL sets all to complete if any are incomplete, or all to incomplete if all are complete
edge_cases: ADD with whitespace-only text is handled by the caller, not the reducer
DELETE/TOGGLE/EDIT with non-existent id returns state unchanged
CLEAR_COMPLETED on empty list returns empty list
TOGGLE_ALL on empty list returns empty list

testing_requirements.target: Each reducer action type produces correct state transformation
Edge cases return state unchanged when appropriate
